# RIV

The objective is to detect pattern or trend in the recruitment of the patient

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(CptPointProcess)
# library(rivpipeline)
library(sas7bdat)
#rkd_file <- "C:/Users/COQM/OneDrive - Trinity College Dublin/Matthieu Coq/Diagnosis Date analysis/danish cohort/cluster_danish_data (3).sas7bdat"
rkd_file <- "cluster_danish_data (3).sas7bdat"
rkd <- read.sas7bdat(rkd_file)

rkd_filter=rkd

rkd_filter$Date.of.diagnosis= as.Date("1960-01-01") + rkd_filter$mid_date

rkd_selected=rkd_filter

rkd_selected=rkd_selected[order(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis),]



library(lubridate)

barplot(table(day(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis)),main="Distribution of days")

barplot(table(month(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis)),main="Distribution of months")

barplot(table(year(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis)),main="Distribution of years")


plot(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis,1:length(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis),type='s',ylab="", xlab="Date of Diagnosis")

```

The above graphics shows the inclusion rate.

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
rkd_selected$Interval_in_day=as.numeric(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis-rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis[1])

```



The 2 graphics above show the distribution of the interval of time. 
A changepoint model based on Poisson process is applied to find cluster of inclusion rate. 

```{r}
dat=as.data.frame(cbind((rkd_selected$Interval_in_day+1)/(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2), 1:length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)))
colnames(dat)=c("times", "marks")
Res.Seg=CptPointProcess(dat, Kmax=10, selection = F)
plot(Res.Seg$Contrast + (1:10)*log(nrow(dat))) ## use BIC because cross-validation breaks for these data 


Res.Seg=CptPointProcess(dat, Kmax=10, selection = T)
Res.Seg$SegK

#png("RIV changepoint plot.png", width = 6, height = 6, units = 'in', res = 3000)
graphics::par(new=FALSE)
plot(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis,1:length(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis),type='s',ylab="Number of patient included", xlab="Date of Diagnosis")
points(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis, rep(0,length(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis)),pch=20)
if (nrow(Res.Seg$SegK)!=1){
  graphics::abline(v=as.Date(Res.Seg$SegK$end*3998.5,min(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis))[1:(length(as.Date(Res.Seg$SegK$end*3998.5,min(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis)))-1)], col=2, lty=2)
}

graphics:: par(new=TRUE)
graphics::plot(0, xlim=c(min(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis), max(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis)), ylim=c(0, 250), col=0,
               xlab=NA, ylab=NA, main=NA, axes=FALSE)
for(k in 1:nrow(Res.Seg$SegK)){
  graphics::lines(c(as.Date(Res.Seg$SegK$begin[k]*3998.5,min(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis)), as.Date(Res.Seg$SegK$end[k]*3998.5,min(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis))), (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda[k]*365/3998.5)*c(1, 1), col=2, lwd=2)
}
graphics::axis(side=4, col=2, col.ticks=2, col.axis=2)
mtext("rate per year", side=4,col=2,line=-1)
#dev.off()
```


The modelisation of the changepoint model through a exponential distribution works well.

## Interval between diagnosis date

We calculate the interval in days between the a diagnosis data and the following one.

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
rkd_selected$Interval=c(0,diff(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day))

```







```{r}
dat=as.data.frame(cbind((rkd_selected$Interval_in_day+1)/(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2), 1:length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)))
colnames(dat)=c("times", "marks")
Res.Seg=CptPointProcess(dat, Kmax=10, selection = T)
SegK <- Res.Seg$SegK

K <- length(SegK$end)
tau_vec <- c(0, SegK$end)*(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2)
tau_vec[K+1] <- tau_vec[K+1] - 2
# tau <- Res.Seg$SegK$end[1]*(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2)-1
n = length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)

# tsim <- rep(0, n)
simChDat <- function(SegK){
  K <- length(SegK$lambda)
  x0 <- 0
  for(k in 1:K){
    # sel_1 <- rkd_selected$Interval_in_day >= tau_vec[k]
    # sel_2 <- rkd_selected$Interval_in_day < tau_vec[k+1]
    # nk <- sum(sel_1 & sel_2)
    # tsim1 <- rexp(n, (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2))[1])  
    daily_lambda_k <- SegK$lambda[k] / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day))
    ## Mimic data collection process - averaged to preserve privacy 
    tsim1 <- rexp(3*n, daily_lambda_k)
    tmat <- matrix(tsim1, nrow = 3)
    tsim <- colMeans(tmat)
    sel <- (cumsum(tsim) + max(x0)) < tau_vec[k+1]
    x0 = c(x0, max(x0) + cumsum(tsim[sel]))
  }
  # x0 <- x0[-1]
  
  # plot(y = 1:length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day), x = x0, type="s", lwd = 1,xlab="Interval in day", ylab="")
  # abline(v=tau_vec, col="red")
  x0
}

x0 <- simChDat(SegK)

nsim <- length(x0)

x0mat <- replicate(5000, simChDat(SegK))
x0 <- x0mat[[1]]
nsim <- length(x0)
plot(ecdf(round(diff(x0))), lwd = 1,xlab="Days", ylab="P(t < T)", col = 3, main = "Cumulative distribution of days between diagnosis events", cex.main=0.7, do.points = FALSE)
#abline(v=tau_vec, col="red")
test2=quantile(ecdf(round(diff(x0))),seq(0,1,0.1))
for(i in 2:5000){
  
  # tau <- Res.Seg$SegK$end[1]*(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2)-1
  # n = length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)
  # tsim1 <- rexp(length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day), (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2))[1])
  # x = cumsum(tsim1)
  # x <- x[x< tau]
  # tsim2 <- rexp(n - length(x), (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2))[2])
  # x <- c(x, max(x) + cumsum(tsim2))
  # lines(y = 1:n, x = x, type="s", col = 3)
  
  x0 <- x0mat[[i]]
  nsim <- length(x0)
  lines(ecdf(round(diff(x0))), col = 3, do.points = FALSE)
  test2=rbind(test2,quantile(ecdf(round(diff(x0))),seq(0,1,0.1)))
}
test3=colMeans(test2)
lines(ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval),col=1)
```

```{r}
y1 <- ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval)
q1 <- quantile(y1, rep(0:10)/10)
q1[which.max(q1)] <- 1e6
q1 <- unique(round(q1))
tab1 <- table(cut(rkd_selected$Interval, breaks = c(0,3,7,14,21,1e6), include.lowest = TRUE))
ysim <- round(diff(x0))
exp_sim <- table(cut(ysim, breaks = c(0,3,7,14,21,1e6), include.lowest = TRUE))/length(ysim)
c1 <- chisq.test(tab1, p = exp_sim)
print(c1)
barplot(c1$stdres)

#png("RIV plot.png", width = 6, height = 6, units = 'in', res = 3000)
plot(ecdf(round(diff(x0))), lwd = 1,xlab="Days", ylab="P(t < T)", col = 3, main = "Cumulative distribution of days between diagnosis events", cex.main=0.7, do.points = FALSE,xlim=c(0,100))
#abline(v=tau_vec, col="red")
test2=quantile(ecdf(round(diff(x0))),seq(0,1,0.1))
pvalue=NULL
resi=NULL
ysim <- round(diff(x0))
exp_sim_total=table(cut(ysim, breaks = c(0,3,7,14,21,1e6), include.lowest = TRUE))
for(i in 2:5000){
  
  # tau <- Res.Seg$SegK$end[1]*(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2)-1
  # n = length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)
  # tsim1 <- rexp(length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day), (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2))[1])
  # x = cumsum(tsim1)
  # x <- x[x< tau]
  # tsim2 <- rexp(n - length(x), (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2))[2])
  # x <- c(x, max(x) + cumsum(tsim2))
  # lines(y = 1:n, x = x, type="s", col = 3)
  
  x0 <- x0mat[[i]]
  nsim <- length(x0)
  lines(ecdf(round(diff(x0))), col = "gray", do.points = FALSE)
  test2=rbind(test2,quantile(ecdf(round(diff(x0))),seq(0,1,0.1)))
  ysim <- round(diff(x0))
  exp_sim <- table(cut(ysim, breaks = c(0,3,7,14,21,1e6), include.lowest = TRUE))/length(ysim)
  c1 <- chisq.test(tab1, p = exp_sim)
  resi=rbind(resi, c1$stdres)
  pvalue=c(pvalue, c1$p.value)
  exp_sim_total=exp_sim_total+table(cut(ysim, breaks = c(0,3,7,14,21,1e6), include.lowest = TRUE))


}
test3=colMeans(test2)
lines(ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval),col=1)
#dev.off()
boxplot(pvalue,main="distribution of the p-value of the Chi-squared test",outline=F)
boxplot(resi, main= "distribution of the residual error of the Chi-squared test", outline=F)

exp_sim_total=exp_sim_total/sum(exp_sim_total)
print(exp_sim_total)
print(tab1)
c1_overall <- chisq.test(tab1, p = exp_sim_total)
saveRDS(c1_overall, file="RIV Chisq test")
print(c1_overall)
print(c1_overall$p.value)
barplot(c1_overall$stdres, main = "Chi-squared test residuals")
```
